cases.name: list on the legacy settings defaults
list with a stale active id
list refuses a newer schema
cases.expectedError: overlay-layouts.json was created by a newer Arc Power version

cases.name: save a minimal new layout inherits the settings defaults
save a minimal layout on legacy settings
save with no argument rewrites the default layout
save reorders an existing layout to the end
save falls back for a 65 character name
save dedupes stats and drops non-strings
save replaces a non-array stats list with the default
save inherits device keys from the settings
save keeps null device keys on legacy settings
save inherits background enablement from the settings
save keeps an explicit disabled background
save a null background inherits colors but not enablement
save rejects a bogus advanced position
save a twenty-first layout is dropped at capacity
save an existing layout at capacity still lands
save with a trailing argument uses the first
save refuses a newer schema
cases.expectedError: overlay-layouts.json was created by a newer Arc Power version

cases.name: rename without a name keeps it
rename with a blank name keeps it
rename with a 65 character name keeps it
rename a null payload
cases.expectedError: Cannot destructure property 'id' of '(intermediate value)(intermediate value)(intermediate value)' as it is null.

cases.name: rename refuses a newer schema
cases.expectedError: overlay-layouts.json was created by a newer Arc Power version

cases.name: select with a trailing argument uses the first
select on a stale active id repairs it
select refuses a newer schema
cases.expectedError: overlay-layouts.json was created by a newer Arc Power version

cases.name: delete the last remaining layout
cases.expectedError: The default overlay layout cannot be deleted

cases.name: delete the active layout falls back to the first
delete an inactive layout keeps the active id
delete an unknown id keeps the document
delete a non-string id keeps the document
delete refuses a newer schema
cases.expectedError: overlay-layouts.json was created by a newer Arc Power version
